verdicts.reason: A keeps the orange tint over most of the canvas, but the white line frame is now an empty, shrunken box that no longer holds any text. The copy order is jumbled: 'Tickets available' sits above 'Richmond High School Theatre presents', and the supporting lines are close to the headline in size. The orange overlay also stops short of the top, and an oversized arrow sits in a black dead band at the bottom. B is worse because it loses the brand's orange wash: the raw purple/blue photo shows through, and a meaningless empty orange rectangle floats in the middle. The frame lines are gone apart from a broken fragment colliding with the arrow, and the same jumbled text sits directly on the busy crowd photo with weaker contrast.
